purpose: Controlled cost replay of the exact frozen T1/S1 common-refresh trajectories, not new seeds or architectural search. Measure full specified pipeline cost and fixed-endpoint target attainment; retain all failures and trade-offs.
ordering: Six case/seed blocks use all six method permutations once; alternating T1/S1; each method occupies each position twice. One GPU worker process at a time; no other project training, rendering, bulk analysis or hashing during a timed solve.
process: Fresh Python process for each run, two OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS/Torch CPU threads, deterministic CUDA, TF32 off. Warm CUDA/model kernels with 50 identical full-objective backward evaluations using disposable half-Fourier model and original case points before measurement; no optimizer. Fixed eight-second inter-run rest. AC power required. No clock, driver, software or environment installation changes.
idle_gate: Before each worker, measure system CPU over 2s and query GPU. Require AC power, CPU<=15%, GPU utilization<=10%; if a gate fails, stop before timed run (do not silently discard/retry completed runs). Record baseline and continuous GPU telemetry every 2s. Desktop background processes are not killed. WDDM process-memory attribution may be unavailable; do not claim perfect hardware isolation.
cost_boundary: Primary warmed-process solve elapsed starts before domain normalization, reconstruction of P1 geometry cover and sampling support cover, original seed point generation, method-specific uniform Gaussian construction if needed, model initialization/transfer, all refreshed point generation, cache preparation, optimizer setup, training and checkpoint/trace recording. Record checkpoints at all 400-step blocks, but accuracy endpoints only800/1600. Full elapsed includes lightweight monitoring and checkpoint I/O; component compute times also reported. Process startup/warmup, post-run byte-verification, reference evaluation and parent inter-run rest are outside solve elapsed and reported separately when measurable. No cached construction can erase its cost.
common_preprocessing: All three methods require geometry/support cover for the fixed shared-probe comparison protocol; charge and label this common cost for every method. This is not the cheapest standalone Fourier workflow. Report common cost separately from representation and optimization.
reproduction: Regenerated centres, widths and all four point blocks must exactly equal frozen inputs. All four checkpoints must match original tensors bitwise, and accepted steps/closures must match. On mismatch stop cost-to-accuracy inference; do not reuse old errors for a changed state.
accuracy_use: Only after all timed solves finish and exact replay checks pass, reuse byte-verified P2J/P2K error/engineering/distribution metrics. No FEM-based stopping, selection or tuning during timing. Targets are first observed at800/1600 only, not exact first-passage times; report nonattainment and later loss. No successful-only pooled speedup when methods have different successful runs.
inference: After1600, separately time generation of10000 fixed uniform solid queries (seed67001) and batched prediction of all five outputs; save predictions and query coordinates. These outputs are reference-free, not extra accuracy selection.
resources: Same110705 trainable parameters; reset torch peak allocated/reserved counters per run; sample worker RSS and system CPU/AC every0.5s. Retain measured peak sampled RSS, baseline RSS, telemetry and process envelope. Distinguish allocation from total GPU usage and sampled from exact host-memory peak.
stop: Exactly18 timed replays; no added seeds/arms/budgets. Numerical/reproduction/nonfinite/AC/idle-gate failure stops dependent work and is reported. Preserve all completed costs.
